capabilities: Seal notes into .knobe.md knowledge objects with a SHA-256 integrity payload
Verify sealed records for integrity, body verification, and spec conformance
Transform verified originals into derivative objects linked by parent hash
Design and load assignment journeys with per-step AI policies and pre-filled context
Batch-verify a folder of submissions and export a CSV of verdicts
extras: Marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README warns it is not a compliance certification and does not enforce access control. Binary formats (PDF, DOCX) must be converted to text before import.
intentEvidence: brings the full Studio to your vault
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to seal notes as tamper-evident knowledge objects with attribution and lineage, or to verify and grade collections of student submissions against an assignment chain.

relations.evidence: Verification and sealing run on knobe-core.js, the official KNOBE Protocol v1 JavaScript engine
earlier versions came with the Teaching Studio as a separate plugin, KNOBE Teaching Studio
An Obsidian dashboard modeled on the steward's browser workbench, KNOBE Studio

summary: Vault-native dashboard for creating, verifying, transforming, and adapting sealed KNOBE Protocol v1 knowledge objects, with assignment journeys and cohort checks.
